summary: 搭建和调试纯 three.js r187 游戏或三维场景：导入映射、场景、透视相机与渲染器、动画循环、窗口缩放、轨道控制和 WebGPU 渲染器。 Sets up and debugs a plain three.js r187 game or 3D scene: import maps, Scene, PerspectiveCamera and WebGLRenderer, setAnimationLoop with Timer, resize, OrbitControls and WebGPURenderer. Use on "Failed to resolve module specifier three", a black canvas or nothing animating. Not for GLB loading (`threejs-gltf-loading`), materials (`threejs-materials-lighting`) or React Three Fiber.
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill threejs-scene-setup，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use on "Failed to resolve module specifier three", a black canvas or nothing animating.
Workflow: Read `three` from `package.json` or the import map; Resolve `three` and `three/addons/`; Create the scene, camera and renderer; Prove the pipeline with an unlit mesh first.

需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：threejs-gltf-loading 用 gene_gdsk_threejs_gltf_loading_v1，threejs-materials-lighting 用 gene_gdsk_threejs_materials_lighting_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
